rules: Method: TOP_DOWN_MASTER_SKELETON mandatory; global parameters published ONLY by the skeleton (V2-REQ-CAD-001/002); independent V2 root required; no cyclic references and no ACTIVE external OreSat/vendor CAD references (V2-REQ-CAD-003; vendor_exact_B601_STEP is on the excluded list).
Every first-level object must carry properties: object/owner/class/state/source/frame/mass/claim (V2-REQ-CAD-004).
Evidence-state vocabulary is closed: EVIDENCE_BOUND / DESIGN_PROPOSAL / UNKNOWN_BLOCKED / EXCLUDED. DEFAULT, ASSUMED_TRUE, TYPICAL, or 'looks plausible' are forbidden substitutes.

Five named configurations are REQUIRED: STRUCTURAL_REVIEW, SERVICE_ACCESS_REVIEW, DEPLOYED_REFERENCE_Q0, STOWED_PROPOSAL, EVIDENCE_STATE_REVIEW; interference/review results must be bound to a named configuration (V2-REQ-CAD-005).

SHA-256 manifest required for all inputs and deliverables (V2-REQ-CAD-008); native files must reopen/rebuild with complete references (V2-REQ-CAD-007); V1.0 CAD, Gates, geometry config SSOT, accepted B601 URDF and simulations must remain byte-unmodified (V2-REQ-CAD-006).

Excluded from active assembly (never mate/contact/rigid-lock): target_satellite, target_debris, physical_TCP, contact_geometry, selected_camera_hardware, selected_propulsion_hardware, vendor_exact_B601_STEP. Targets are independent-scene only (IF-TG-001 EXCLUDED).
Mechanical mount transform is T_SM only; substituting T_SB for T_SM is an immediate stop condition. T_SB use is free_flyer_base_only and currently UNKNOWN.

No unsourced bolt patterns, locating features, hole positions, fasteners, preload, fit/tolerance, materials, surface treatment, loads (F_M/M_M), stiffness/strength/modal targets — all IF-RM-001 unknown_fields stay null with named owners (ICD sec 3.2).
CAD default material/mass must never override the mass-owner registry (global_rules.default_material_or_mass_authority: false; ICD sec 9 stop condition).
Perception interface IF-PL-001: only reserve_mount_region, reserve_cable_passage, occlusion review owner. Forbidden: camera_model, numeric FOV, T_SC values, calibration, mass, BOM.
End-effector IF-EE-001: only preserve_G, preserve_E_virtual, reserve_future_interface. Forbidden: physical_TCP, contact_patch, force_sensor, compliant_finger_claim.

Solar interfaces IF-SA-L/R: allowed = root plane, hinge-axis candidate, stowed/deployed/safe-display state slots, swept keepout owner. Unknown = hinge, release, lock, drive, harness, stowed_envelope, deployment_loads. Static deployed positions must NOT be called deployment verification.
Load-path chain existence means topology completeness only — never claim strength/stiffness/load qualification; reaction-path view claimed as strength verification is a stop condition.
Serviceability without explicit clearance/fastener/tool data may only be labeled SERVICEABILITY_PROPOSAL (ICD sec 8).
q0 deployed-reference 10-interference NEGATIVE_RESULT must be inherited unchanged (V2-REQ-MEC-010); global collision safety remains BLOCKED.

Middle bay: non-overlapping volume owners for OBC/C&DH, EPS/PMAD, battery, RW/IMU; rear bay: separated propulsion/comm/thermal-radiator/debug reserved zones with keepout owners only (no hardware/performance).

Immediate stop-and-request-new-ruling triggers: profile or envelope change; T_SM / M / A0 / B601 topology change; V1.0 seal mismatch; any request to fill unknown material/load/property; target/contact/sensor/physical TCP entering active CAD; missing B3 human authorization.
Claim limit everywhere: NON_FLIGHT_DISPLAY_ONLY; no standard-12U/CDS compliance claim; no flight, FEA, dynamics, manufacturing or capture-feasibility claims (authority block: all false).

conflicts_or_gaps: 授权边界冲突（最重要）：全部六份文件一致声明 CAD 未授权（CAD_EXECUTION: false / b3_cad_authorized: false / create_v2_cad_now: false / cad_authoring_authorized: false / CAD_AUTHORING: NOT_AUTHORIZED），且明确 B2.5 裁决只允许'申请 B3'。本次 B3 CAD 构建的授权必须来自这些文件之外的人工 B3 批准记录——构建前需向 orchestrator 确认该批准存在，否则触发文件内'B3 人工授权缺失'停止条件。
frame G 在 ICD IF-EE-001 中被引用（G/E_virtual/TCP，preserve_G）但未在 configuration baseline 的 frames 节定义，本包内无 G 的数值定义——需从 accepted B601 URDF/A3 证据侧获取，且不得修改。
E_virtual 标为 EVIDENCE_BOUND 但本包无任何数值 transform；CAD 只能'保持'它，不能自行赋值。
M 面 X=185.25 mm 超出 body_max_X=170.25 mm 共 15 mm（恰为 160x160x15 flange 厚度）：flange/adapter/B601 均位于 340.5 mm body envelope 之外。文件未声明包络是否含突出物；构建时按'body envelope 仅约束 bus 本体'处理并在证据导出中注明，不得据此改包络。
术语不一致：00_governance 用 'UNKNOWN_DISABLED'（T_SB、physical TCP），其余文件用 'UNKNOWN_BLOCKED'。语义一致（不可用），CAD 属性建议统一用 register/baseline 的 UNKNOWN_BLOCKED。
Ry(+90°) 只给了旋转量，未明文规定 M 系哪根轴为安装面法线/B601 插入轴——需与 T_SM nominal_frozen_v1 的 SSOT 定义（20_engineering/config/geometry/）对拍，不得自行解释。
IF-PL-001 的 frame_id 为 'T_SC_future'、IF-TG-001 为 'T_ST_or_T_SD'——transform 名被用作 frame_id 的命名不一致；建 reference 时保持原字符串，勿'修正'。
mass owner registry 与 unknown register、Master Skeleton 参数表、volume-owner register 在 ICD/需求中被引用但不在本 6 文件集内（应在 04/05 目录）——由其他 reader 覆盖，若缺失则 B2.5 退出条件不满足。
CDS_12U_REFERENCE 366.0 mm 包络与 340.5 mm profile 并存：非冲突，但被标 RETAINED_REFERENCE_NOT_CONSUMED + change_control_required，CAD 严禁消费 366 数值。

任务授权中的'维护线束 reference'对应模块 Service_Access_and_Harness_References、'太阳翼接口'对应 Solar_Array_Interface_Module——均在 active modules 清单内，无冲突；但'舱段占位'的三舱 evidence_state 均为 DESIGN_PROPOSAL，属性必须如实标注而非 EVIDENCE_BOUND。
notes: CAD 可直接消费的骨架参数闭合集：S 原点=包络中心，X∈[-170.25,+170.25]，分舱面 X=±56.75；T_SM=[185.25,0,0]+Ry(+90°)；flange 160x160x15 → adapter plate 160x160x12 + boss D100x15 → A0=identity；F_L/F_R=[-56.75,±113.15,0]。所有物理连接字段（螺栓/公差/材料/载荷）must stay null。9 个 active modules + 5 个具名配置 + 4 值 evidence-state 词表 + SHA-256 manifest 为交付硬合同。
